title: Power Meter Zero-Offset Failure Queue
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=powermeter:ride
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(zero_offset_ok="true")) as successful by _time bike_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for power-meter zero-offset checks by bike.
value: Zero-offset success rate keeps calibration hygiene visible instead of assuming the numbers are always trustworthy.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for power-meter zero-offset checks events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for power-meter zero-offset checks by bike.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how often power-meter zero-offset checks works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
